capabilities: Assign an alias to any command
Find commands in the command palette by typing their alias
Remove aliases from the plugin's settings tab
extras: The README is very brief and includes developer setup instructions (npm install, npm run dev) but no screenshots or examples.
intentEvidence: Open the command palette and enter an alias in the box to narrow down the command.
motivation: The README suggests the author added aliases because translated command names help understanding but are tedious to type.
problem: Command names in Obsidian can be hard to remember or tedious to type, especially when the translated wording does not match how you think of the command.
summary: Command alias manager that lets you assign custom names to commands and find them in the command palette by typing the alias.
